//! Writes two databases whose table t carries AUTO_INCREMENT on a column
//! that is not its primary key: one in its WAL alone, one in a snapshot

use stoolap::Database;

fn write(dsn: &str, snapshot: bool) {
    let db = Database::open(dsn).unwrap();
    db.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, n INTEGER AUTO_INCREMENT, v TEXT)",
        (),
    )
    .unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t (id, v) VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b')", ())
        .unwrap();
    if snapshot {
        db.execute("PRAGMA SNAPSHOT", ()).unwrap();
    }
    db.close().unwrap();
}

fn main() {
    let out = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("an output directory");
    write(
        &format!("file://{out}/wal_column?checkpoint_on_close=off&checkpoint_interval=0"),
        false,
    );
    write(
        &format!("file://{out}/snapshot_column?checkpoint_interval=0"),
        true,
    );
}
